Body.Content:
Azure DevTest Labs gives developers on-demand, self-service, Azure-based test environments. It increases IT efficiency by controlling costs with the required governance in place. With DevTest Labs you can:
  • Quickly provision development and test environments.
  • Minimize waste with quotas and policy enforcement.
  • Set automated shutdowns to minimize costs.
  • Create a VM in a few clicks with reusable templates.
  • Get going quickly by using VMs from pre-created pools.
  • Build within Windows and Linux environments.
  • Integrate directly with your preferred CI tool, IDE, or automated release pipeline.
For more information, please visit the Azure DevTest Labs page.
